name: Ashiya (Fukuoka, Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Ashiya town emblem in white: an outlined lozenge of angular strokes enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ashiya, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 19 February 1974.

features.role: Ashiya town emblem — an outlined lozenge of angular strokes enclosing a stylised character
